3e3a6286cb1eade9a79d8b8392c6c47e.overview: Musical adaptation of Charles Dickens' Oliver Twist, a classic tale of an orphan who runs away from the workhouse and joins up with a group of boys headed by the Artful Dodger and trained to be pickpockets by master thief Fagin.
3e3a6286cb1eade9a79d8b8392c6c47e.tagline: Much much more than a musical!

3e9e1c08e9d081d5c587281ea2d3a977.overview: An all-girl rock band moves to Hollywood in the hope of achieving success, only to fall into a whirlpool of wickedness and decadence.
3e9e1c08e9d081d5c587281ea2d3a977.tagline: This Is Not A Sequel. There Has Never Been Anything Like It!

3ed8885974542e006849437d77d35793.overview: The Marquis de la Chesnaye and his wife host a weekend gala where a variety of complicated romantic and social entanglements between guests and servants lead to tragedy, all against the backdrop of a looming war.

3efaf83140bb1550b143477c8bd2d0e9.overview: Baron Frankenstein creates two "zombies" - one male, one female - planning to mate them in order to create a master race.
